column1: They are applied to {branch} oldest first.

column1: They are applied to {branch} oldest first. Conflicts stop the sequence for you to resolve or abort.

column2: 此操作无法撤销：重命名、冲突、文件夹和子模块将在不保存副本的情况下被丢弃。
